title: Validator vote to delist MAV, MAVIA, MEW, PROMPT, SCR, TST, USTC, YZY, and ZEREBRO
content: {"blocks":[{"key":"dehs8","text":"Validators will vote on whether to delist MAV, MAVIA, MEW, PROMPT, SCR, TST, USTC, YZY, and ZEREBRO on May 5 around 9:00 UTC, based on community member stalequant's methodology and community request. ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"hr34","text":"This permissionless stake-based vote weighting primitive is built natively into HyperCore and technically requires no offchain coordination. If validators vote to delist an asset, the perps will settle to the 1 hour time weighted spot oracle price before delisting, and open orders will be canceled. Close any positions beforehand to avoid automatic settlement. After settlement, no new orders will be accepted.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}
